experiment: P5o protocol-generic verified-idle shared frozen-forward and dense bounded-head execution
decision: Do not rerun P5o, do not alter the P5o protocol or executor on its consumed identities, do not generate confirmation data, and do not open any independent or locked test.

cause.stage: after pre-data integration validation, train-only generation, zero-overlap audits, and guarded GPU launch; before a normal result or exception receipt was flushed
cause.observed: The launched P5o Python process later disappeared and its pre-created output root is empty: neither result.json nor pre_result_abort.json exists.
cause.attribution: unattributed abrupt process termination. A focused Windows Application/System event-log query did not produce a process-specific Python fault or a time-correspondent CUDA-driver incident that can be assigned to P5o.
cause.why_no_model_conclusion: The executor writes a pre_result_abort receipt for catchable Python exceptions and result.json on normal completion. An empty root therefore has no valid equivalence, latency, guard, or model metric; it is execution-infrastructure failure evidence only.

evidence.post_termination_check: 2026-08-04; no p5o Python command line present; output root exists and has zero entries
evidence.event_log_check: Application Error, Windows Error Reporting, and selected System providers queried over 2026-08-04 20:20-21:05 local; no P5o-attributable process crash/driver event retained

data_disposition.identity_disposition: quarantined_for_P5; no rerun, selection, confirmation, calibration, or test on these identities

next_allowed_action: Only a separately preregistered checkpointed P5 successor may be considered. Before fresh data generation it must write an immutable launch receipt and per-pool completion checkpoints, validate recovery behavior without performance evaluation, then use wholly new identity pools.
